title: Generic Local Research And Prototype Planning
summary: Create a reusable research dossier and prototype outline for a locally selected technical objective.
objective: Turn a broad technical objective into evidence-backed deliverables that a human operator can review.
scope: Identify the system boundary and key interfaces.
Map reusable knowledge or skill packs before requesting external evidence.
Produce local evidence artifacts only unless governance explicitly allows more.
success_criteria: All generated artifacts are local, reviewable, and redacted.
External retrieval remains validated and governed.
Autonomy can explain the next bounded step.
